substitution: bWAR reads eWAR v2 (incumbent); eWAR reads published fWAR (candidate)
strata: side, season, fold, debut cohort band; never a consensus-FV cell

definitions.ewar_v2: career_war.seasons_ewar_v2 (the incumbent the step C rebase keeps)
definitions.fwar: career_war.seasons (published fWAR, as the table serves it)
definitions.twin: eWAR v2 plus the fWAR-minus-eWAR v2 deltas permuted across players within (season, side)

label_bases.rows: the Estar arm of step F, relabelled per basis under Estar's own window rule

hit._reading: diagonal difference = the basis's effect on the margin. The off-diagonal cells separate 'the model learned the new label' (fit_fwar__score_ewar_v2) from 'the label got easier for everyone' (fit_ewar_v2__score_fwar). Rows are the Estar arm; every other factor is held at its Estar value, so this cell isolates the basis.

pit._reading: diagonal difference = the basis's effect on the margin. The off-diagonal cells separate 'the model learned the new label' (fit_fwar__score_ewar_v2) from 'the label got easier for everyone' (fit_ewar_v2__score_fwar). Rows are the Estar arm; every other factor is held at its Estar value, so this cell isolates the basis.

hit.disposition: RULED OUT (equivalent within the registered margin)
hit.estimator_note: E_cond is primary; E_refit is reported beside it.
hit.floors_note: nine of the thirteen standard cells carry E_cond floors of 0.0203 to 0.0322 (note 4); UNDECIDED is the expected pitcher reading
